materialization_findings.finding: Required-content lists do not fix exact admissible bootstrap/context forms, independent trust-anchor delivery before payload, or shared atomic role-claim transport through current channels.
materialization_findings.limit: Safety intent is not contradictory; implementation readiness and complete application are not established. No new trust mechanism or instance was constructed.

materialization_findings.finding: CallerCompletionEvidence requires full observer CreationIdentity even for FAILED/UNKNOWN. If identity acquisition fails, null is forbidden and no explicit caller fallback-form mapping is specified.
materialization_findings.limit: Other failure forms allow unknown identities; their use as the external replacement receipt is not bound. No false successful run is claimed.

assessment_summary.interpretation: Documentation establishes requirements; no unchanged implementation is promoted to corrected code. M1-M3 remain within existing six blockers.

positive_findings: All six original blockers map to exactly one S2-FG group; all 21 acceptance clauses are accounted for.
Four private sources are byte-identical to S2-FE; eight existing modules and historical source/evidence bindings are unchanged.
Normal observer admission/dispatch ordering, owned process handles, native identity/exit checks and original receipt validation exist in code.
Existing supervisor control.finish precedes LiveRecordingCompletion; it is not removed or described as absent.
Observer candidate return and later caller terminal evidence can be ordered without a self-hash cycle; they are not the same event.
Missing numeric certificate, historical metadata limits and absent current fourth-parent admission stay explicit.
